integrity: Analytical infinite-dimensional proof, elementary rational-verifier checks, complete citation of the originating generator, no third-party text reproduced beyond short formulas necessary to define it; no independent audit claimed.
limitations: No characterization of positivity-time sets of arbitrary semigroups; the coordinate cutoff is sufficient but need not be sharp; the generic nowhere-positive phenomenon on C(K) was published in 2016.
scientific_scope: The explicitly defined real self-adjoint contraction semigroup on ell^2(Z); the unperturbed construction and individual eventual strong positivity are credited to Dobrick (2026). The added result is the all-time negative off-diagonal entry with an explicit sufficient coordinate cutoff.
title: Only time zero is positive for a compact-resolvent self-adjoint eventually positive semigroup
